items.prompt: The point (3, −2) is reflected in the y-axis. What are the coordinates of its image? Write them like (2, 3).
hints: The y-axis is the vertical line through zero.
A reflection in it changes the sign of one coordinate.
The point stays the same distance from the axis, on the other side.
items.explanation: Reflecting in the y-axis changes the sign of the x-coordinate. (3, −2) becomes (−3, −2).

items.prompt: A triangle has a corner at (−1, 4). It is translated 5 units right and 6 units down. What are the new coordinates of that corner? Write them like (2, 3).
hints: Right changes the x-coordinate and down changes the y-coordinate.
Right adds to x. Down subtracts from y.
items.explanation: −1 + 5 = 4 and 4 − 6 = −2. The new corner is at (4, −2).

items.prompt: The point (2, 3) is rotated 90° clockwise about the origin (0, 0). What are the coordinates of its image? Write them like (2, 3).
hints: Picture (2, 3) in the top right quarter.
A clockwise turn takes it into the bottom right quarter.
The distances from the axes swap: 3 across and 2 down.
items.explanation: A 90° clockwise turn about the origin takes (x, y) to (y, −x). So (2, 3) goes to (3, −2).
